_about: Which countries count for a question. Every group is limited to UN member states (rows not in countries.json `notSovereign`). Rules are written so a player can predict them; edge cases are listed in `notes` and get checked by the adversarial agent.

sovereign.label: a UN member state
sovereign.rule: All World Bank rows except those in countries.json notSovereign.

island-nations.label: an island country
island-nations.rule: UN member states whose entire territory is on islands (sharing an island with another country still counts).
island-nations.notes: Denmark, Malaysia, Equatorial Guinea and Yemen have major islands but also mainland territory, so they are excluded. Australia is treated as a continent.

reasons.AUS: Australia is a continent, not an island country.

eu.label: an EU member state
eu.rule: The 27 member states of the European Union.
